messages:
incident-bot: Pager: high error rate observed on /v1/generate (us-east-1). Incident ticket INC-2026-324 created. Runbook: tokenization-regression. Grafana: https://grafana.company/alerts/INC-2026-324
Marcus L.: oncall here, mitigating. rolled back canary to model v2-rc3, reinstating old routing. scaling up dedicated pool 2->4 GPUs.
Marcus L.: brief metrics: 5xx rate peaked ~1.2%, p95 latency +350ms for ~14m. small number of sessions saw dropped tokens.
Priya R.: thanks. any known customer-facing failures? need to loop in CSMs if yes.
Marcus L.: two customers reported errors via support (CS-9032, CS-9033). both experienced request failures ~14:03-14:11 UTC.
Emily C.: noted. I can prepare interim customer comms. Daniel, can you own postmortem and timeline?
Daniel K.: I’ll own the RCA writeup. target: draft in 48hrs, peer review in 72hrs, sign-off EOD +5. putting items in the action docket now.
SRE Rotation: timeline uploaded to /shared/incidents/INC-2026-324/timeline.md (contains event markers and audit logs).
Marcus L.: quick root cause hypothesis: a recent quantized kernel change (deploy at 13:58) led to a cache-key mismatch under specific prefix sizes, causing KV cache thrash and OOM-like failures. reverting fixed immediate errors.
Priya R.: can you paste the deploy hash and PR? also need logs to verify user scope.
Marcus L.: PR https://git.company/pr/4728, deploy hash a1b2c3f. logs pulled to /logs/2026/1798804321-INC-2026-324.log
Marcus L.: command used to extract error counts: ```bash
curl -s "https://logs.company/api/query?job=runtime&since=15m" | jq '.events[] | select(.level=="error")' | wc -l
```
Daniel K.: action item: confirm impacted model versions + exact customer API keys used (for scope). Priya: can you coordinate with support to get API keys sanitized for the writeup? assign to @Priya R.
Priya R.: on it, pinged support and CSMs. I'll attach redacted request IDs.
Emily C.: Legal: please review if any PII in logs before we paste snippets. @Legal Bot can you do a quick scan?
Legal Bot: received. ETA 24h for a preliminary scan, flagging any PII exposures.
Marcus L.: added temporary mitigation: disabled new quantized kernel flag for model family X, added guard in runtime to fallback on cache mismatch exception.
SRE Rotation: created checklist in the draft postmortem: - timeline - contributing factors - mitigation steps - corrective actions - customers impacted - monitoring gaps.
Daniel K.: drafting timeline now. initial factual timeline: 13:57 deploy PR-4728 -> 13:58 canary traffic 5% -> 14:01 errors increase observed -> 14:03 pager -> 14:05 rollback to previous kernel -> 14:09 error rate normalizes.
Priya R.: tagging CS for outreach: @cs-alex, @cs-jordan. please hold templates for interim and final comms.
Emily C.: interim comms ready, needs final impact numbers.
Marcus L.: logs show ~1,230 failed requests during window, ~410 distinct API keys, 2 with >25 failures each.
Daniel K.: note for RCA: contributing factors to evaluate: (1) insufficient load testing for kernel variation, (2) missing pre-release prefix-size unit tests, (3) lack of quick rollback test in deploy playbook.
Priya R.: putting a remediation ticket: REM-2026-55 - add unit tests for prefix sizes and a deploy rollback smoke test.
Marcus L.: adding runtime metric: cache-miss-ratio and kv-exception-rate to alerting with 5m burn-in.
Daniel K.: peer reviewers: @Marcus L., @Priya R., @Emily C. Please review draft when I post.
SRE Rotation: draft link: https://docs.company/postmortems/INC-2026-324-draft.md (private).
Daniel K.: request: exec summary paragraph for customer-facing note (2-3 lines) + impact numbers. Emily can you draft after I add numbers?
Emily C.: will draft. ETA 6h after Daniel posts final counts. :memo:
Legal Bot: legal review queued. if any PII found we'll redact and re-run comms.
Daniel K.: assigning action items now: ACTION-1 assign owner Marcus L. - add cache mismatch guard (due 48h). ACTION-2 assign owner Priya R. - customer outreach & redactions (due 24h). ACTION-3 assign owner Eng QA - add unit tests (due 7d). ACTION-4 assign owner SRE - add alerts & dashboards (due 48h).
Priya R.: confirmed owners in tracker. I'll update support tickets with interim note and link to draft.
Marcus L.: will follow up with PR for guard and tests this afternoon.
SRE Rotation: after postmortem sign-off, schedule a runbook update session and a short blameless postmortem presentation for eng-infra.
Daniel K.: thanks everyone. I'll post the first draft by EOD tomorrow. please add any extra evidence to the shared folder. once draft is stable we'll schedule peer review and legal signoff. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Postmortem draft created: https://docs.company/postmortems/INC-2026-324-draft.md. Reminder: add reviewers in the doc metadata to trigger review workflow.
